defendant: Christian Community Foundation Inc. d/b/a WaterStone

caption: Pinkert v. Schwab Charitable Fund et al.

claims_or_theory: Breach of fiduciary duty: excessive fees and costlier investment options paid to affiliate
outcome_or_holding: Dismissed for lack of Article III standing (N.D. Cal. 2021); affirmed by the 9th Cir. in 2022. Commentary notes the court left open whether advisory privileges are an enforceable right

caption: State of Alaska v. GoFundMe; PayPal; Charity Navigator; JustGiving; Pledgeling; Network for Good (six suits)
court: Alaska state court (not specified in sources)
defendant: GoFundMe, PayPal Inc./PayPal Giving Fund, Charity Navigator, JustGiving, Pledgeling, Network for Good (ForGood)
defendant_type: giving platforms incl. DAF-sponsor-backed pages (PayPal Giving Fund)
dispute_type: consent to use charity names / unauthorized donation pages
claims_or_theory: Alaska Charitable Solicitations Act (consent before fundraising for a charity); Alaska Consumer Protection Act / Unfair Trade Practices
outcome_or_holding: None reported. Seeks page removal, an accounting, and civil penalties of $1,000-$25,000 per violation
notes: A 21-AG multistate letter to GoFundMe (March 2026) is related, but it is a letter, not litigation.

caption: California Attorney General cease-and-desist order: Flipcause
court: California AG administrative order (appeal filed by Flipcause 2025-12-12 per press)
defendant_type: fundraising platform / payment intermediary (not a DAF sponsor)
claims_or_theory: Gov. Code 12580 et seq.; not properly registered as a fundraising platform (AG). The order also references a 2019 notice to register as a professional fundraiser (press)
status_as_of_2026-11-15: Order issued. Flipcause in bankruptcy (2025-12). Penalty: the AG sought up to $70,000 per its release; press reports it as a fine
outcome_or_holding: Ordered to stop operations in CA, account for charitable assets since 2015, and move cash to a blocked account
notes: The amount is the more-than-$29M owed per NPQ (the bankruptcy figure). The CA release itself lists about $500k reported by 14 charities.
